title: Allotrope 1
summary: Six layers of geometry drive six electronic instruments. Rhythms emerge directly from the rotation of the shapes, without quantisation, and geometric proportions are mapped to equal-tempered synth notes.

descriptions.content:
Seis camadas de geometria comandam seis instrumentos electrónicos. Os ritmos surgem directamente da rotação das formas, sem quantização, e as proporções geométricas são traduzidas em notas de sintetizador em temperamento igual.

Fotografia de capa: José Hipólito (2022).

Six layers of geometry drive six electronic instruments. Rhythms emerge directly from the rotation of the shapes, without quantisation, and geometric proportions are mapped to equal-tempered synth notes.

Cover photograph: José Hipólito (2022).
